messages:
bob_tenant_ops: We're seeing a surge of 429s on dedicated-prod-3 starting 09:07 UTC. API returns rate_limited and tail latency 2-3x. The spike followed a bulk ingestion of long contexts (~80k-120k tokens) from a single tenant.

alice_support: Thanks — can you share a sample request id or curl? Streaming or single-shot? Any recent config changes?

bob_tenant_ops: Single-shot. Sample (sanitized):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-70b","input":"<very long document...>","max_tokens":4096}'

alice_support: Escalating to eng-runtime. @carol_runtime can you pull kv metrics for dp-3? Suspect cache pressure.

carol_runtime: Pulling. Quick snapshot: kv_evictions_per_min: pod-dp3-01=1500 pod-dp3-02=1300 pod-dp3-03=900; kv_hit_ratio dropped 0.7->0.32; mem_fragmentation ~0.77; inflight_long_contexts=17 (mostly tenant=acme-inc). Looks like a single-tenant blast causing eviction and local throttles -> 429s.

dan_sre: Any autoscaler logs? Did the cluster fail to scale fast enough? Also confirm if routing concentrated requests to same pods.

bob_tenant_ops: We pinned acme-inc to dp-3 for throughput. They kicked off an ingestion job this morning.

carol_runtime: Mitigations: 1) Ask client to chunk documents / reduce max_tokens (short-term). 2) Enable per-tenant KV soft quota to reject new long-contexts. 3) Rolling restart to defrag allocators. I'll canary restart one pod.

alice_support: Please include diagnostic commands for SRE/devs.

carol_runtime: Commands: 
# per-pod kv stats
curl -s http://pod-dp3-01.internal/_internal/kv_stats | jq .
# prometheus
rate(kv_evictions_total{pod=~"pod-dp3-.*"}[5m])

bob_tenant_ops: Reduced request length client-side — 429s reduced ~70% but tail latency still elevated.

deploy-bot: Started rolling restart on dedicated-prod-3 (group=dp-3) initiated by @carol_runtime at 2026-03-17T10:12:15Z :gear:

carol_runtime: Can confirm pod-dp3-01 restart reduced eviction_rate ~80% on that node and cache_hit climbed to ~0.68. Continuing rollout.

carol_runtime: Follow-ups: full rolling restart, short-term per-tenant soft quota/alert, investigate allocator fragmentation and consider periodic defrag on heavy nodes.

eve_pm: Noted customer impact — preparing message for acme-inc. ETA for full remediation?

carol_runtime: ETA ~30-45 mins for full restart + config push. Recommend acme-inc throttle ingestion to <=5 concurrent long-context requests until we finish. Will update when done. :thumbsup:
